raj: Heads-up — EU usage ingest dropped gpu_utilization column around 03:10 UTC, forecasts for eu-west show ~12% undercount for last 24h. ingesters show parse warnings. :eyes:

ingest-bot: job 'eu-usage-ingest-03' ERROR: schema mismatch for field 'gpu_utilization' (expected float, got null) — retry count 2

maria: on it. if it's only EU we can map missing -> 0 for short-term and backfill missing rows. will run a backfill; need SQL to recompute gpu_hours from tokens/sec metric?

olivia: mapping to 0 skews short high-util bursts. better to estimate using avg util per instance-hour by instance_type for the same hour. quick SQL below to recompute single-day window:

```sql
WITH base AS (
  SELECT instance_type, hour_bucket, avg(coalesce(gpu_utilization, avg_util)) AS est_util
  FROM usage_raw
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT instance_type, hour_bucket, avg(gpu_utilization) AS avg_util
    FROM usage_raw WHERE gpu_utilization IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY instance_type, hour_bucket
  ) t USING (instance_type, hour_bucket)
  GROUP BY instance_type, hour_bucket
)
INSERT INTO usage_processed (ts, instance_id, gpu_hours)
SELECT u.ts, u.instance_id, (est_util/100.0) * u.elapsed_hours
FROM usage_raw u JOIN base b USING (instance_type, hour_bucket)
WHERE u.gpu_utilization IS NULL AND u.region = 'eu-west';
```

simon: +1 to estimate based on instance_type/hour. also add a short-term dashboard tile 'gpu_hours_estimate (auto-filled)' so ops can see impact. can you add a changelog note in forecasts dashboard? @maria

maria: will add tile. opening backfill job now — ETA ~25m. i'll also add a lightweight data-quality check: alert if ingest_rows(region, last_1h) < 90% of baseline

raj: thx. ops-bot, please mute forecast alerts for eu-west for next 30m (we'll post when done)

ops-bot: Forecast alert suppression applied for channel #eng-infra for 30m by raj

maria: backfill finished, ran recompute for last 48h. brief diff: total gpu_hours +8.3% for eu-west. pushed new values to forecast feed. dashboard updated.

olivia: can we add a schema lint step to the stream that rejects missing gpu_utilization unless flagged with 'maintenance' tag? reduces silent falls.

raj: yes. create a tiny PR with the lint rules and I'll review. good catch everyone. closing loop: we'll keep the estimate tile for 24h and then revert to raw once dqo is in place. :thumbsup:
